children: Calumet expanded its asset-based revolving credit facility commitments to $600 million through the Eleventh Amendment to its Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, led by Bank of America as administrative agent. In a coordinated move, the company also executed a Fourth Amendment to its Monetization Master Agreement with J. Aron to permit the higher facility size. The actions are intended to enhance liquidity and keep monetization arrangements aligned with the company’s financing structure.
